metadata.description: 会话行菜单「删除对话」：永久删除会话（磁盘日志、投影缓存、归档/置顶记账），级联删除它派生的子代理会话，运行中一律拒绝；同菜单还能复制原始会话 ID。 | DSH session-row "Delete conversation" — permanently deletes a session, cascades into the subagent sessions it spawned, refuses live ones, and copies the raw session id.
